meta.title: Competitor 360 — Master Data (consolidated schema v2)
meta.scope: B2C only (B2B parked per Jai, Meeting 2)
design_notes: Component rows are FIXED (see component_registry) and render for every zone; dash where not applicable.
Cell value is dynamic: cost = max(0, selectedQty - free_allowance) * unit_fee. Shows 'Included' when present but charge is 0; dash when not applicable.
Itemised zones (Meydan, IFZA) build cost from per-component fees. Bundled zones (RAKEZ, Ajman) carry the cost in the tier price; component rows mostly 'Included'.
max_visas on a package powers the gray-out: if selected visas > max_visas, that package column greys out.
Every leaf has confidence + source. value:null = to be filled. Do NOT treat assumed cells as final.
meta.how_to_fill: Replace null values and update confidence to 'confirmed' when real figures land. See open_questions at the bottom for exactly what is missing and who owns it.

confidence_legend.confirmed: Official source (price list / factsheet) or directly confirmed.
confidence_legend.assumed: Estimate / placeholder — overwrite when real data lands.
confidence_legend.missing: No data yet — value is null.
confidence_legend.na: Not applicable for this zone (renders as dash).

zones.compute_note: Total = licence(flat) + shared_desk + (establishment_card if visa>=1) + visa_allocation*visas + residence_visa_fee*visas + medical*visas + emirates_id*visas + (status_change if inside UAE). Multi-year 15% discount applies ONLY to licence + visa_allocation.

multi_year.note: 15% discount applies to licence + visa_allocation ONLY. Shared desk charged PER YEAR (confirmed). Establishment card assumed PER YEAR (validity-1 per calculator). So multi-year Meydan = (licence + allocation) x years x 0.85 + (card + desk) x years at full price + visa/medical/EID charged every 2 years.
